name: Monstera Deliciosa
description: The Swiss Cheese Plant is famous for its natural leaf holes. A stunning focal point for any bright room.
care: Bright, indirect light. Water when top inch of soil is dry.

name: Mexican Sycamore
description: A fast-growing shade tree with beautiful silvery-white undersides on its leaves. Very hardy in Texas heat.
care: Full sun. Low to moderate water once established.

name: Red Yucca
description: Not a true yucca, but a tough-as-nails evergreen with striking coral-red flower spikes.

name: Sago Palm
description: A slow-growing cycad that adds a prehistoric look to any landscape. Very drought tolerant.
